# ThunderStudy AI

> ThunderStudy AI is a free educational tool at https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/. Its Formula Story Mode turns any formula or concept into a story, a real-life analogy or a memory trick, for Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology and more. It is owned, built and maintained by Wondermayank, a solo student developer who has been building free educational tools since 2018. No account, card or ads. Last updated: 3 October 2026.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/): Turn any formula into a story, real-life analogy or memory trick with ThunderStudy AI. Free for Physics, Chemistry, Maths and Biology, by Wondermayank.
- [Formula Story Mode](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/app): Use Formula Story Mode to turn any formula into a story, analogy or memory trick. Free AI tool for Physics, Chemistry, Maths and Biology, with PDF export.
- [About](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/about): About ThunderStudy AI and its owner Wondermayank: who runs the site, its mission and what it offers.
- [FAQ](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/faq): Answers about ThunderStudy AI: it is free, needs no account, and covers subjects, story styles, the 5-a-day limit, the free library and saving stories.
- [Changelog](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/new): Newest-first list of what Wondermayank added, fixed, improved and removed, with dates.
- [Formula library](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/formula): All 16 free formula pages for Physics, Chemistry, Maths and Biology.
- [Physics formulas](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/physics-formulas): Formula stories and memory tricks for Physics.
- [Chemistry formulas](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/chemistry-formulas): Formula stories and memory tricks for Chemistry.
- [Maths formulas](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/maths-formulas): Formula stories and memory tricks for Maths.
- [Biology formulas](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/biology-formulas): Formula stories and memory tricks for Biology.
- [How it works](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/how-it-works): The four steps from formula to story, with a short FAQ.
- [Examples](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/examples): Example story, analogy and memory trick outputs.
- [Hindi page](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/hi): Hindi introduction to ThunderStudy AI, for students who prefer Hindi.
